description: Pre-registered comparative inferential evaluation protocol for the first M0 (lexical+CPC) vs M1 (lexical+semantic+CPC, ADR 0016 fusion) pilot comparison over the sealed 45-pair benchmark.

models.M0: Lexical BM25 + CPC concordance baseline (no semantic artifact wired)
models.M1: Lexical + semantic (frozen embedding, ADR 0014) + CPC, fused per ADR 0016

hypotheses.description: Primary endpoint (PR #44): wiring the frozen M1 semantic embedding improves nDCG@10 over the lexical+CPC baseline.
Secondary endpoint: M1 improves Recall@5 over the lexical+CPC baseline.
Secondary, pre-registered endpoint (mirrors H01_M1_vs_M0_MRR in config/evaluations/comparisons_m0_m6.json, not reinterpreted): M1 improves strict MRR over the lexical+CPC baseline.
